title: Ada Research — Void Tower System Atlas
thesis: Technology is trapped in convention, yet in essence a potential general queer intellect. Ada Research starts as Nature-of-Code tutorials in VR and deliberately lets text, artifacts, machines, body, and space drift apart to form new queer relations inside an unfinished 210-floor skyscraper.

orders.title: 01 · Cumulative Concept Order
orders.subtitle: The Nature of Code spine — what formal, visual, and kinematic rules are permitted yet
orders.rule: Never spoil later chapters early: Monochrome before Color (F28), linear lerp before WaveFunctions (F62), static architecture before transforming space (F13 -> F14).

orders.title: 02 · Desiring-Machine & Capability Order
orders.subtitle: Deleuze & Guattari partial objects, prefabs, robots, and player powers unlocking downward
orders.rule: Machines do not sit alone: each factory, robot, loom, or package releases partial objects or capabilities into Model B's kit that plug unexpectedly into later floors.

orders.title: 03 · Editorial & Witness Order
orders.subtitle: Model B's living void.md book, Ghost Student vertical lessons, and frozen reading editions
orders.rule: The reading route can leap, loop, or detour across floors without breaking the skyscraper. Every poetic song breadcrumb pairs with an easy-to-understand plain breadcrumb.

layers.title: Tutorial & Critical Ground
layers.question: What formal mechanism is taught, and where do its conventions leak?
layers.description: The original Nature-of-Code foundation (`tutorial.md`) paired with critical and historical inquiry (`final.md`, `critical.md`). Drift between text and room is deliberate and tracked.

layers.title: Care Unit Model B (Camera · Breadcrumbs · void.md)
layers.question: What does Model B photograph, sing, and write into the living Void book?
layers.description: Model B is the protagonist co-authoring with Palle and AI models: camcorder HUD receipts, poetic Inner Opera song breadcrumbs paired with plain-language handles, and the growing `void.md` manuscript.

layers.title: The Void Tower Architecture
layers.question: How does the unfinished skyscraper hold this floor, its shafts, and vertical leaks?
layers.description: 210 stacked concrete and scaffold floors linked by Shaft A, Shaft B, structural columns, work lights, and open weather so floors visibly bleed into one another.

layers.title: Desiring-Machines, Robots & Prefabs
layers.question: Which robot, factory, or assemblage wakes up here, and what partial object travels forward?
layers.description: 291 authored prefabs plus factories, looms, vending rigs, catalysts, and robots that organize fragments of the ontology and couple into downstream floors.

layers.title: Queer Ontology & QFEP Underneath
layers.question: How does code or space refuse false neutrality, expose norms, or activate queer desire?
layers.description: Operational queer intellect in code and world: denaturalizing standardized codes, re-coupling partial objects across incompatible systems, holding bodily remainder and Gödelian outsides.

layers.title: Body, Costume, Stickers & Care
layers.question: How is Model B's body clothed, marked, fatigued, cared for, or transformed here?
layers.description: Model B's mutable queer surface — knit shell, tailored suit, super-drag outfit, badge tee, surface stickers, BodyCharge fatigue/recovery, and bodily aperture encounters.

layers.title: Generative Grammars & Substrates
layers.question: Which formal code-to-form grammar or living substrate drives the geometry here?
layers.description: Nine domain grammar engines (primitive, mesh, pattern, L-system, graph, morphology, noise, reaction-diffusion, trajectory) plus substrates and biome layers.

layers.title: Sonic, Voice & Acoustic Architecture
layers.question: What sings, what stays silent, and how do acoustics and impacts feel on Quest 3?
layers.description: Quest-safe GDScript phoneme singing, 0.9 s gaze-settle silence discipline, rain/wind ambience, spatial interaction cues, and unified physical impact boom feedback.

layers.title: Embodiment, Surface Sync & Provenance
layers.question: What is verified on Desktop vs. Quest 3 VR vs. Web/Book, and what is still planned?
layers.description: Honest separation across Quest 3 VR, Desktop Godot, Three.js Lab Editor, and Book Editions — distinguishing planned drafts, probe receipts, and lived human encounters.
